metadata.description: The Modifyers is a 2007 American animated children's sci-fi fantasy action comedy television pilot created by Lynne Naylor and Chris Reccardi.  The film revolves around a female spy and her robotic sidekick tasked with stopping a supervillain.  The Modifyers was made for Nickelodeon in 2007, but never aired.
